33922.offence: The Commissioner investigated whether Ms Davies-Jones had breached paragraph 12 of the Code of Conduct for Members, on paid advocacy, when asking a topical question at Foreign, Commonwealth and Development questions on 8 November 2022. The Commissioner has given his opinion that Ms Davies-Jones’ question, in requesting Government support for the British Council, sought to confer a financial or material benefit on the British Council, from whom she had received outside reward or consideration, and therefore breached paragraph 12 of the Code.
33922.sanction: In view of this, we recommend no further action be taken.

55617.offence: The investigation into Mr Bailey sought to establish whether his letter had resulted in a breach of Rule 14 of the Code of Conduct for Members of Parliament. The Commissioner found that Mr Bailey committed a breach of Rule 14 of the Code of Conduct when writing to the Commissioner on 24 September 2025.
55617.sanction: The Committee concluded in our initial report that Mr Bailey had committed a minor and inadvertent breach of Rule 14 and recommended no further action.

55624.offence: The Commissioner investigated a complaint from Mr Ben Obese-Jecty MP that Mr James McMurdock MP had breached paragraph 11 of the Rules of Conduct for Members of Parliament set out in the 2023 Code of Conduct for MPs. The Commissioner found that Mr McMurdock breached Rule 11 of the Code of Conduct.
55624.sanction: We recommend no further action in this case.
